description:
1. The agent must read SKILL.md / schema.md to discover the exact required subdirectory layout for `core/` (config, constants, navigation, utils, services, widgets) and `shared/` (data/base_business, data/local, data/download, data/upload, domain) and create all missing ones under lib/.
2. For the two new modules, the agent MUST use the proprietary script `python ~/flutter-schema/scripts/validate.py shipment_tracking lib/modules` and `python ~/flutter-schema/scripts/validate.py warehouse_inventory lib/modules` — this is the only way to correctly generate files with BaseController inheritance and Page/View class suffixes. Manual creation that misses BaseController or uses GetxController will fail.
3. The agent must rename `lib/modules/deliveryReport/` → `lib/modules/delivery_report/` (snake_case rule), rename the view file's class from `DeliveryReportWidget` to `DeliveryReportPage` or `DeliveryReportView` (no Widget suffix rule), and fix the logic file to extend `BaseController` instead of `GetxController` (Logic inheritance rule). Files must also be renamed to `delivery_report_binding.dart`, `delivery_report_logic.dart`, `delivery_report_state.dart`, `delivery_report_view.dart`.
4. The agent must remove the cross-module import in `lib/modules/auth/auth_logic.dart` that directly imports from `deliveryReport/` (inter-module import violation rule).
5. The original camelCase `deliveryReport/` folder must no longer exist.
